title: What If Everyone Moved To Texas?
description:
What if everyone on Earth moved to Texas? Texas covers about 696,000 square kilometers. Spread 8.3 billion people out evenly and each person gets roughly 80 square meters, about 12,000 people per square kilometer. That is less crowded than Monaco (about 18,000 per km²) and Manhattan (about 29,000 per km²). So the whole world would fit in Texas, with room to spare on the rest of the planet.

Sources: Wikipedia, 'Texas', 'Monaco', 'Manhattan', 'World population'. Pure arithmetic: it ignores food, water, housing and everything else. Figures are estimates; ratios are calculated by us.

What 'what if' should we do the math on next? Tell us in the comments.
